scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
...
......
向战士们致敬。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
We are the warriors
of the desert. Nobody
looks down upon us.
Nobody...
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
我们是沙漠的战士。
谁也不能轻视我们。
谁也不能...

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
The time has come.
The world needs you...
More than ever.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
时机已到。
世界需要你...比以往任何时候都更需要。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
I ask that you continue to live in the shadows, but as an even greater Assassin with a new appearance.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
希望你继续隐身于暗影之中，以全新的姿态，成为更强大的刺客。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Will you become
an Assassin Cross?
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
你愿意成为十字刺客吗？

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
When you are
ready, come back.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
准备好了，再回来吧。

[十字刺客]
向战士们致敬。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
You still haven't
learned everything
that you can.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
你还有能学的技能尚未掌握。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Use all your
Skill Points
and then come back.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
用完所有技能点，再回来。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Congratulations.
As an Assassin Cross,
I hope that you fight for a brighter future within the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
恭喜。
愿你身为十字刺客，在黑暗中为光明的未来而战。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
在这里安心休息吧。
向战士们致敬。
